decisions.reason: As a newly launched complementary plugin with no visible evidence of underperformance yet, it is likely to be retained while management learns whether it can meet aspiration levels.

The ERP interface plugin may be somewhat costlier to support, but as a recent product with potential strategic value for client integration, it would likely be kept unless results clearly fall below aspirations.
Because it sits in a cluster of similar price comparison tracking plugins, internal comparison raises its removal risk, but the short market history still favors continued trial.
Management would likely keep this product for now, though overlap with other tracking plugins makes it more exposed to later culling if it does not distinguish itself against aspiration levels.
This plugin faces elevated risk from portfolio redundancy, yet boundedly rational management in a German service-software context would usually allow more time before dropping a recent launch.
As a recent net price reporting add-on that likely complements existing client work, it would probably be retained while management assesses demand and fit with the established business.
